verdict.rationale: Exa ships a ready-made `web_search` tool for OpenAI and Anthropic tool-call loops, where `webSearch()` with no arguments applies recommended agentic settings. It also offers an official open-source MCP server that works with ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, VS Code and any other MCP client, plus agent skills for coding agents. Together these cover direct tool-call consumption well. Missing for 10: explicit published function-calling JSON schemas, evidence of named agent-framework integrations such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, a public OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the tool integrations.
